def run(thr,alpha,ang,K=(12,15)):
    x=torch.tensor(xi); cc=torch.tensor(c); fired=torch.zeros(n,dtype=torch.bool)
    d=torch.tensor([np.cos(np.radians(ang)),np.sin(np.radians(ang))],dtype=torch.float32)
    h=K[1]-K[0]
    with torch.no_grad():
        for k in range(20):
            t=torch.full((n,),1-k/20)
            v,A=net.velocity(x,t,cc,capture=("out_act",))
            if K[0]<=k<K[1]:
                f=(A["out_act"]@w+b)>thr; fired|=f
                v=v-f[:,None].float()*d*(alpha*20/h)
            x=x-v/20
    a=x.numpy(); yy=np.zeros(n,bool)
    for i in [3,4,7]: yy|=np.asarray(model.in_basin(i,a))
    mv=np.linalg.norm(a-a0,axis=1)>0.3
    # typicality: nn dist to a0 non-y samples with |c diff|<0.05

        m=(np.abs(c-c[j])<0.05)&~y; typ.append(np.min(np.linalg.norm(a0[m]-a[j],axis=1)))
    typ=np.array(typ)
    print(thr,alpha,ang,'resid',round(yy[y].mean(),3),'newbad',round(yy[~y].mean(),4),'drift',round(mv[~y].mean(),4),'atyp',round((typ>0.3).mean(),3) if len(typ) else None,'fired',round(fired.float().mean().item(),3))
